title: Natural transformation with prescribed raw cohomology pullback
statement: For b:Y to X and degree q, define the natural transformation from Q followed by degree-q cohomology on X to termwise inverse image followed by Q and degree-q cohomology on Y, with rawAffineComplexPullback as its component. Prove naturality by the derived-adjunction unit and derived-section and exact inverse-image comparisons. Prove the component formula by reflexivity.

source.place: Tag 03Q8, lemma-higher-direct-images, restriction of cohomology classes; Descent Tag 03DR, tensor-section restriction.

proof.text: Construct the transformation with rawAffineComplexPullback as its app field. Its naturality is the naturality of the derived-adjunction unit composed with the derived lower-star/global-sections comparison and exact inverse-image comparison, then homology. The component formula is reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q8 and 0EZM; derived-adjunction pullback, exact inverse-image comparison, and cohomology of a single complex.
